title: A host hears when a member asks to join their event, or says they are going

source.ref: Unwired-things scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner: full approval to make it all right

detail:
On an event that needs the host's approval, an RSVP was written as pending with no notice to anyone, so the guest waited on a host who never knew a request existed; a plain going RSVP did not reach the host either. Both RSVP paths (first RSVP and re-join) now send the host an event.notice (rsvp_request: asked to join, rsvp_going: is going), so the host's own in-app Events switch decides.

DONE 2026-11-18.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
